name: com.getmcpads/snapchat-ads
title: Snapchat Ads
description: Snapchat Ads MCP server: 21 read tools, 25 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPCHAT_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated ad account UUIDs this server may use. Required, even for reads.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPCHAT_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Snap Marketing API access token. Expires after an hour; prefer the refresh credentials.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPCHAT_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token, so the server can renew the access token in memory.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPCHAT_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Snap Marketing API OAuth app, needed for renewal.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPCHAT_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of that OAuth app, needed for renewal.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPCHAT_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true exposes the 25 write tools. Defaults to false. Writes preview until confirm:true.
